evidence: Floor canister vacuum with cord rewind push-button and ball body architecture.
Single-tier radial orange cyclones surrounding a central blue washable filter cap.
Transparent dust bin carry handle with an integrated red release push-rod mechanism characteristic of the classic Dyson Ball cylinder range (DC37/DC39).
contradictions: Dyson Big Ball features two-tier radial cyclones or filterless Cinetic cones with an integrated collar dirt-ejector bin rather than a single-tier orange cyclone assembly with central blue filter cap and arched clear handle.

candidate_checks.evidence: Target exhibits a classic Dyson Ball (DC37/DC39) single-tier radial cyclone with central blue filter cap and clear handle, which conflicts with Big Ball cyclone and bin architecture.
Target is a corded cylinder vacuum with a cord rewind button and ball canister body, contradicting a cordless stick machine.
Presence of a cord rewind button and spherical wheeled canister body is incompatible with the cordless handheld V8 format.
